title: Global lore/quest stay at 0.12.0 (DEC-161): bare lore check exits 7 in this repo by design
description: Drift note for the next session, from opum-doc (2026-10-07 about 21:59Z). The workstation global lore and quest STAY at 0.12.0: they were upgraded at 21:54Z and rolled back at 21:56Z because 9 unmoved repositories schema-drift under lore 0.13.0. The global moves last, after a per-repository pin move parked behind DEC-161 (opum-agent OPAG-1258). This repository already moved (opum-lore pin v0.13.0, and .lore/schemas regenerated in OMARK-86), so a bare global lore check (0.12.0) exits 7 here: 10 schema-drift plus 1 schema-unattributable (standard.schema.json), measured at 21:56Z. That is EXPECTED, not breakage - the post-write hook emits exactly this on every quest write. For local docs checks here use npx 0.13.0 (npx --yes @opum-ai/lore@0.13.0 check); the CI lore check job installs the 0.13.0 pin, so it is green. Do NOT run lore schema export or lore sync to silence it. This task is a To Do marker so the exit 7 is not misread as a fault and is closed only when the global reaches 0.13.0.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The global lore and quest reach 0.13.0 (after the per-repository pins move, behind DEC-161 / OPAG-1258), at which point a bare lore check in this repository stops exiting 7
